name: e1_bridge_layers
_purpose: Phase 1a of the expanded accuracy-improvement round: sweep --bridge-layers (zero new code, already a CLI flag) on top of final_retrain_v3's winning config (dropout=0.15, K=16, token-order=question_first, word-dropout=0.15, lr=1e-3, wd=0.01). Use checkpoint_val_acc (the corrected, newly-added metrics field -- NOT best_val_acc, which was discovered to be the historical max across epochs rather than the actual restored checkpoint's value) for triage. Control (bridge-layers=2) vs deeper bridges.
